title: Salmon Cream Cheese Roll
description: Salmon, tangy cream cheese and cucumber in a simple nori-outside roll.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Cook salmon until done, then let cool slightly and break into long, substantial flakes. Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Cut cream cheese into chilled batons and cucumber into dry, narrow strips. Keep the cheese cold enough to handle.
Spread prepared rice over the nori, leaving the far border clear. Line up salmon, cream cheese and cucumber without overfilling; roll tightly.
Cut into eight pieces with a damp knife, cleaning the blade between cuts to avoid dragging cream cheese.
notes: Use lemon sparingly so it complements rather than dominates the cream cheese.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
